title: Dual-eye consensus and confidence scoring
description: Implement detection/eye_consensus.py to evaluate probabilities from both detected eyes, determine frame-level eye closure state, apply sensitivity weighting, and compute detection confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluates probabilities from left and right eyes using conservative consensus logic
Marks eyes as closed only when both detected eyes exceed threshold (or single eye if only one is clearly detected)
Calculates confidence score based on eye detection clarity and crop quality
Marks state as unavailable if no eyes are detected or detection confidence is too low
Unit tests verify consensus decisions across various probability pairs

steps.details: Create detection/eye_consensus.py with FrameEyeState dataclass and EyeConsensusEvaluator class.
Implement evaluate(probabilities, threshold=0.75) computing combined_closed_prob, is_closed boolean, and confidence in [0.0, 1.0].
Allow sensitivity factor (0.5 to 1.5) to modulate effective threshold.

steps.description: Write unit tests for consensus evaluator
steps.details: Create tests/test_eye_consensus.py testing cases: both closed, both open, one open one closed, no eyes detected.

technicalNotes: Conservative consensus prevents false alarms when a driver glances sideways or winks.
Unavailable state must be returned when no eyes are found.
